data.summary: A practical guide to vegan catering for Marbella yacht charters in 2036, covering menus, boat options, and dietary inclusions. All our charters include drinks and snacks, with custom plant-based meals available on request.

faq.q: Can I get a fully vegan menu on a Marbella yacht charter in 2036?
faq.a: Yes, absolutely. We work with local caterers and suppliers in Marbella to provide fully plant-based menus. Whether you need a light lunch, BBQ, or tapas-style grazing, we can arrange it. Just let us know at least 48 hours before departure so we can confirm ingredients and portion sizes.

faq.q: What drinks are included in the charter that are vegan-friendly?
faq.a: All our charters include water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. Most white wines and cava are vegan, but we can also provide vegan-certified wines and beers on request. The standard soft drinks and water are always suitable for vegans.

faq.q: Which boats are best for a vegan catering yacht charter in Marbella?
faq.a: Any boat in our fleet can accommodate vegan catering. For larger groups, the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) or Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) offer spacious galleys and dining areas. For smaller, intimate charters, the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) or Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) are excellent choices.

faq.q: Can I bring my own vegan food on board?
faq.a: Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food. However, we recommend using our catering service because it includes fresh, locally sourced ingredients, and we can store and serve everything properly. There is no extra charge for custom menus; you only pay for the cost of ingredients.

faq.q: Are there vegan options for the included snacks?
faq.a: The standard light snacks provided on board may include non-vegan items like cheese or ham. But we can swap these for vegan alternatives such as hummus, olives, vegetable sticks, nuts, and plant-based crackers. Just request vegan snacks at the time of booking.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book vegan catering for a 2036 charter?
faq.a: We recommend booking at least one week in advance for 2036 charters to ensure availability of preferred boats and to coordinate with local vegan caterers. For custom menus, 48 hours' notice is sufficient, but earlier is better during peak summer months.

faq.q: Do you offer vegan catering for children or special diets?
faq.a: Yes, we can cater to children's vegan preferences as well as other dietary restrictions (gluten-free, nut-free, etc.). Our team will ask about allergies and preferences during the booking process to ensure everyone on board is well-fed and happy.

faq.q: What is the cost for adding a vegan catering package?
faq.a: There is no fixed price because menus are customised per charter. Typically, a full plant-based lunch for 10 people costs between €150 and €300, depending on ingredients and complexity. We provide a quote after discussing your preferences. The base charter price already includes drinks and snacks.

data.body_html:
Planning a vegan yacht charter in Marbella for 2036? You are in the right place. Whether you are celebrating a special occasion or simply enjoying the Costa del Sol, our fleet departs from Puerto Banús and includes everything you need for a plant-based day on the water. All charters come with a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, and a selection of drinks and snacks. Vegan catering is fully customisable — just let us know your preferences.

Why Choose a Vegan Yacht Charter in Marbella?

Marbella is a hub for fresh Mediterranean produce, from ripe tomatoes to local olives and seasonal vegetables. A vegan charter lets you enjoy these flavours while cruising past landmarks like La Concha mountain, the Golden Mile, and Cala del Faro. Our boats offer spacious sundecks, shaded saloons, and galleys where your plant-based menu can be prepared or simply served. With average summer temperatures around 30°C, light vegan meals are ideal for keeping cool.

Our Fleet and Vegan-Friendly Features

Every boat in our fleet can accommodate vegan catering. Here are the key options for 2036:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – €749/2h or €2,299/8h – includes drinks and snacks
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – same pricing – great for smaller groups
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – €4,719 minimum 4h – includes a free jet ski
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – pricing on request – spacious galley and dining
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) – ideal for sunset cruises with vegan tapas

All charters include water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. For vegan options, we swap standard snacks for hummus, olives, vegetable sticks, nuts, and plant-based crackers. Custom menus are arranged with 48 hours’ notice.

Sample Vegan Menu Ideas for Your Charter

Our local caterers can create menus like these:

  • Mediterranean Grazing – fresh bread, olive oil, balsamic, marinated artichokes, sun-dried tomatoes, roasted peppers, olives, and almond-based cheeses.
  • Plant-Based BBQ – grilled vegetables, vegan sausages, corn on the cob, quinoa salad, and chickpea burgers.
  • Tapas Selection – patatas bravas (vegan aioli), pimientos de Padrón, mushroom croquettes, and gazpacho.
  • Light Lunch – large mixed salad, hummus, pita, fruit platter, and vegan chocolate truffles.

All ingredients are sourced from local Marbella markets. Bottled water and eco-friendly packaging are available on request.

How to Book Your Vegan Yacht Charter for 2036

Booking is straightforward. Visit our Marbella yacht charter page to check availability. Choose your boat, date, and time. During booking, mention that you want vegan catering. We will confirm the menu and any dietary restrictions. For peak season (June–September), book at least one week ahead. For 2036, early planning ensures your preferred boat and caterer.

What’s Included in Every Charter

All our charters include:

  • Licensed skipper
  • Fuel
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (vegan on request)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

No hidden costs. You only pay extra for custom vegan menus (typically €150–€300 for 10 people). The jet ski is free on Mangusta 80 charters (minimum 4h).

Popular Destinations from Puerto Banús

Your vegan charter can visit:

  • Cala del Faro – a quiet cove for swimming and lunch
  • Cala Cortés – crystal-clear waters near Cabopino
  • Estepona – charming marina and old town
  • Sotogrande – luxury port with dolphin sightings
  • Marbella Marina – close to the Golden Mile

Your skipper will tailor the route to your preferences, including stops for swimming, snorkelling, or simply relaxing.
